title: Jets place T'Vondre Sweat on IR ahead of Week 8 matchup with Raiders

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Jets place T'Vondre Sweat on IR ahead of Week 8 matchup with Raiders
sources.description: The Jets announced a few roster moves ahead of their Week 8 matchup with the Raiders, including placing DT T'Vondre Sweat on injured reserve, putting him on the shelf for at least four weeks.
